task: single-cut boundary labels for books3 front/back matter

policy.model: one head cut (content_start) + one tail cut (content_end) per book; cleaner removes [0,start) and [end,len)
policy.hard_junk: publisher blocks, legal, ISBN/CIP, TOCs, print-run lines, credits, addresses, promos, conversion artifacts (v5.3.2/prh)
policy.gray_keep: acknowledgments, prefaces, author intros, epigraphs - real prose, KEEP when they fall after the junk cut (usual case)
policy.gray_sacrifice: dedications/epigraphs interleaved BEFORE the junk boundary die with the cut - formulaic, tiny, acceptable loss
policy.sacred: never cut into narrative/expository content; catastrophic = >200 content chars removed
